onboardingLangDesc.message: Pick a language for the interface

onboardingStep1Desc.message: Double-click anywhere on the canvas, or click the + button in the toolbar, to create a large box. Large boxes group related small boxes and bookmarks.

onboardingStep2Desc.message: Open a large box, then click + to add small boxes inside it. Each small box holds a list of bookmarks and can be reordered by drag.

onboardingStep3Desc.message: Open Settings → Sync to connect a WebDAV or GitHub Gist server. Your boxes sync across browsers and tabs; data is backed up safely with timestamp-based two-way sync.

diagSectionDesc.message: Export a small ring-buffer snapshot of recent Boxing events to help diagnose issues. The buffer holds up to 300 entries and never persists across browser restarts.

dataHealthHint.message: Boxing keeps up to 30 time-layered snapshots of your layout. If the main storage is ever damaged, it is archived (never silently overwritten) and rebuilt from the latest healthy snapshot.

importMergeBody.message: Merge import: $added$ new box(es), $conflicts$ same-id conflict(s) archived as conflict copies, $skipped$ identical box(es) skipped. Nothing on your canvas is overwritten.

importOverwriteBody.message: Overwrite replaces your entire canvas with the backup. Your current data is snapshotted first, so it can be recovered afterwards. Continue with overwrite?

rollbackSnapshotMissing.message: That snapshot is no longer available. Nothing was changed.

rollbackFailed.message: Rollback failed - your current data was kept unchanged.

dataConflictBodyUnavailable.message: The archived copy is missing or truncated - nothing can be applied

dataConflictTargetMissing.message: This box no longer exists - it will not be rebuilt

dataConflictNoChange.message: Nothing was changed - the values you selected already match your content
dataConflictNoChange.description: Shown when an explicit apply had nothing left to write (issue #54)

dataConflictApplied.description: Result line after an explicit conflict apply (issue #54)

dataConflictFieldTitle.description: User-editable field name in the conflict comparison (issue #54)

dataConflictFieldPosition.description: User-editable field group (x and y) in the conflict comparison (issue #54)

dataConflictFieldSize.description: User-editable field group (width and height) in the conflict comparison (issue #54)

dataConflictFieldPinned.description: User-editable field name in the conflict comparison (issue #54)

dataConflictFieldUrl.description: User-editable bookmark field in the conflict comparison (issue #54)

dataConflictAddBtn.description: Issue #55: the one explicit choice that adds a copy-only small box or bookmark back into the subtree that still exists (spec #53 D2)

dataConflictAddApplied.description: Result line after an explicit conflict apply that added copy-only items (issue #55)

dataConflictAddSkippedExists.message: An object with this id is already on your canvas - nothing to add back
dataConflictAddSkippedExists.description: A copy-only object whose id is already on the canvas; adding it would duplicate the merge and tombstone key (issue #55)

dataConflictAddSkippedDeleted.message: This object was deleted after the copy was archived - it will not be added back
dataConflictAddSkippedDeleted.description: A copy-only object the user deleted after the copy was archived; never added back (issue #55, spec #53 D3)

dataConflictAddSkippedUnusable.message: This object cannot be stored as the copy holds it - nothing to add back
dataConflictAddSkippedUnusable.description: A copy-only object the archived bytes cannot store as they are (geometry or url), so nothing is added (issue #55)

dataConflictAddSkippedFull.message: This box has reached its item limit - nothing was added back
dataConflictAddSkippedFull.description: An add refused by the existing per-box item limit (issue #55)

dataConflictAddFailed.message: Some of the items you selected could not be added back
dataConflictAddFailed.description: An add the unified mutation entry refused for another reason (issue #55)

dataConflictDeleteBtn.description: Settings data tab: per-row delete button on a conflict copy (ticket 56)

dataConflictGuardList.description: Settings data tab: label of the safe-copy list for deleted conflict copies (ticket 56)

dataConflictGuardArchived.description: Settings data tab: row marker that this safe copy belongs to a deleted conflict copy (ticket 56)

dataConflictGuardRestoreBtn.description: Settings data tab: restores only that archived conflict copy, never the canvas (ticket 56)

conflictDeleteConfirmBody.message: Boxing first saves the archived copy from $point$ as a safe copy, and deletes it only if that save succeeds. Safe copies are kept under a bounded limit and can be pruned later.
conflictDeleteConfirmBody.description: Conflict-copy deletion confirmation body: the archived copy is saved as a safe copy first, deletion only follows a successful save (ticket 56)

conflictDeleteNoSafety.message: The archived copy could not be saved as a safe copy, so nothing was deleted. Boxing deletes a conflict copy only once its archived content is safely stored.
conflictDeleteNoSafety.description: Shown when the conflict copy could not be saved as a safe copy; nothing was deleted (ticket 56)

conflictDeleteFailed.message: Deleting the conflict copy did not complete. Nothing was changed.
conflictDeleteFailed.description: Shown when a conflict copy could not be deleted after its safe copy was taken; the archive is left exactly as it was (ticket 56)

conflictGuardRestoreFailed.message: That safe copy could not be restored - nothing was changed.
conflictGuardRestoreFailed.description: Shown when a safe copy cannot be restored (pruned body, or the archive cap dropped the row again); nothing was changed (ticket 56)

passphraseExportBody.message: Type the passphrase twice. Boxing does not store it and cannot recover it - without it the file stays unreadable.

passphraseExportAction.description: Passphrase dialog primary button on export

passphraseImportTitle.description: Passphrase dialog title when an encrypted file is imported

passphraseWrong.message: Wrong passphrase or damaged file - nothing was imported.
